stepExplanation: At maximum height, v_f = 0. Using v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2a*delta_y: 0 = 25^2 + 2(-10)*delta_y. So delta_y = 625/20 = 31.25 m
stepBody: Calculate the maximum height reached by the ball. At the maximum height, the velocity is zero ($$v_f = 0$$). Use the equation: $$v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2a \Delta y$$. Remember that $$a = -g = -10 \ m/s^2$$ (acceleration is downward). Give your answer in metres.
